raw_definitions: Definisi : adj 1. made of amber, ambar: an~ necklace, rantai leher ambar; 2. coloured like amber, berwarna /ambar, kuning jingga/: ~ eyes, mata yg berwarna ambar; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : n 1. ( resin ) ambar; 2. ( colour ) warna /ambar, kuning jingga/; 3. yellow traffic light, lampu kuning. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
